newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-NEUTRAL REFEREES NAMED FOR FRENCH TOURNAMENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NEUTRAL REFEREES NAMED FOR FRENCH TOURNAMENT.

text.p: Referees from neutral countries will officiate at the six matches of a World Cup warm-up tournament in France in June.
A French Football Federation spokesman confirmed on Wednesday the following referees for the June 3-11 Tournoi de France:
Kim Milton Nielsen (Denmark) France v Brazil, June 3 in Lyon
Ilkka Koho (Finland) Italy v England, June 4 in Nantes
Said Belgola (Morocco) France v England, June 7 in Montpellier
Serge Muhmenthaler (Switzerland) Brazil v Italy, June 8 in Lyon
John Jairo Toro Rendon (Colombia) Brazil v England, June 10 in Paris
Antonio Lopez Nieto (Spain) France v Italy, June 11 in Paris
